mapper.sql: id, name, description, model_id, file_url, format, animation_manifest_json, base_stats_json, active, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM game_characters
WHERE active = 1
ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_characters ( id, name, description, model_id, file_url, format, animation_manifest_json, base_stats_json, active ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{modelId}, #{fileUrl}, #{format}, #{animationManifestJson}, #{baseStatsJson}, CASE WHEN #{active} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET name = excluded.name, description = excluded.description, model_id = excluded.model_id, file_url = excluded.file_url, format = excluded.format, animation_manifest_json = excluded.animation_manifest_json, base_stats_json = excluded.base_stats_json, active = excluded.active, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE game_characters SET active = CASE WHEN #{active} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
